textbookBox.concept: Infrastructure is the vast network of structures and services that keep cities and villages functioning: roads, railways, airports, ports, power, water supply, communication and more.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Infrastructure is the vast network of structures and services that keep cities and villages functioning: roads, railways, airports, ports, power, water supply, communication and more. A developed India, said Dr A. P. J.
beats.speakEn: Infrastructure is the vast network of structures and services that keep cities and villages functioning: roads, railways, airports, ports, power, water supply, communication and more. A developed India, said Dr A. P. J.

beats.en: Local roads help children reach school, farmers carry crops to markets and ambulances reach hospitals. National highways and expressways, built and maintained by the central government, join cities across states.
